author: mostafa_gawad
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists for JUMP ANIMATION
content: WE'RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS. JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project! Requirements: Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds. Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate. Ability to match an established cartoon art style. Attention to detail and good artistic skills. Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance). Send your CV and Portfolio to: jobs@jumpanimation.com or gawad26@gmail.com. You can also message us directly through Facebook!

author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Writers & More
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE. We're looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. Positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more. These positions are paid but we're open to collaboration / internships. Please send a PROFESSIONAL email to: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with: Name, general location, Position applying for, Resume/Portfolio, Rate per panel & for 60 panels, Rates for services, Turnaround Time, Programs / Software used, Preferred Payment Method (PayPal), Other notable experience. NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE. ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE.

author: young.onion
title: Hiring Kawaii Artists for Stationery Collection
content: WE ARE HIRING KAWAII ARTISTS! Calling all creators of all things cute, pastel, and absolutely adorable! We are on the lookout for talented artists to bring their kawaii magic to our upcoming stationery collection! If you love drawing chubby characters, happy little stationery, and sweet pastel doodles, we want to see your work! From journals and stickers to washi tapes and pens. How to apply: Follow us @young.onion, comment with favorite emoji and tag a friend, Send us a DM with a link to your portfolio or fill out the application form in our bio! You can also mail us info@youngonion.in
